errors.account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Locked for 15 minutes.
errors.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the admin.
errors.cannot_change_self: You can't change your own admin role or active state.
errors.invalid_order: Couldn't save the order. Refresh and try again.
errors.playback: This song can't be played. Skipping to the next one.
errors.playbackStopped: Playback stopped. Check the connection and press play again.
errors.abs_invalid: Check the Audiobookshelf address (http://…) and the API key.
errors.abs_unauthorized: The API key is wrong or does not belong to an admin account.
errors.abs_unreachable: Cannot reach Audiobookshelf. Check the address and port.
errors.abs_bad_response: Unexpected response from Audiobookshelf. Check its version.
errors.ai_off: No AI API key is set.
errors.ai_busy: Another image is being made. Try again shortly.
errors.ai_unauthorized: The AI API key is not valid.
errors.ai_quota: The AI usage limit was reached. Try again later.
errors.ai_rejected: The AI service did not accept the request. It may be the prompt or the model setting; the server log line "ai banner" has the actual reason.
errors.ai_no_image: The AI returned no image. Try a different prompt.
errors.ai_bad_response: Could not read the AI service response.
errors.youtube_not_configured: YouTube search is not set up (YOUTUBE_API_KEY).
errors.youtube_quota: YouTube refused the search: today's quota is used up, the key lacks YouTube Data API v3, or the key has an HTTP referrer (website) restriction. You can still paste a link.
errors.youtube_unauthorized: The YouTube API key is not valid.
errors.video_bad_link: That is not a YouTube video link.
errors.video_not_found: The video does not exist or is private.
errors.video_not_embeddable: This video can only be watched on YouTube.
errors.video_exists: This video is already in the list.
errors.smart_playlist: Songs cannot be added to a smart playlist by hand.

settings.title: Settings

settings.audiobooksHelp: Used by the skip buttons in the player and on the lock screen. Saved in this browser only.

admin.title: Admin
admin.libraryDesc: Picks up new, changed and deleted files in the music folder.
admin.purgeConfirm: Delete songs missing for 30+ days? They will also disappear from playlists and liked songs.
admin.foldersDesc: Set a kind for each folder directly under the music folder. Changes apply from the next scan.
admin.folderSaved: Saved. Applies from the next scan.
admin.noFolders: There are no folders under the music folder.
admin.foldersHelp: Albums: artist/album folders (an "Unofficial" or "비정규" folder under an artist is marked unofficial) · Compilations: grouped as Various Artists when the album artist tag is missing · Charts: each subfolder is one chart, kept out of the album list · Themes: each folder of songs is one theme (a folder in between is its category, CD1/CD2 merge), kept out of the album list · Excluded: not scanned (tracks already in the library turn missing and are removed, with their playlist and favorite entries, by the missing-track cleanup)
admin.absDesc: Copies book details, chapters and covers edited in Audiobookshelf, plus each user's listening position, once. Both must use the same audiobook folder and Audiobookshelf must be running. Afterwards Audiobookshelf can be turned off. Run a scan first so the books exist here.
admin.absKeyHelp: Create one in Audiobookshelf Settings → API Keys. It is not stored; delete it in Audiobookshelf after the import.
admin.absUnmatchedHelp: No book with the same folder was found here. Check that AUDIOBOOK_PATH is the Audiobookshelf library folder and that a scan has finished.
admin.absUsersHelp: Pick a muzplayer user for each Audiobookshelf user. Same usernames are matched automatically.
admin.aiDesc: Admins make and edit banner images with AI on chart and theme pages.
admin.aiCounts: {banners} AI banners · {without} collections without a banner (covers are used)
admin.aiHelp: Add {key} to .env and restart the app to use it. The key stays on the server, never in the page or the database.
admin.rebuildCoversConfirm: Remake every album and audiobook cover from the music files? It runs as a scan and takes a while.
admin.rebuildCoversStarted: Started a scan that rebuilds the covers
admin.scanCancelled: Scan stopped (songs read so far are kept; nothing marked missing)
admin.scanInterrupted: Scan interrupted by an app restart (scan again to continue)

charts.title: Charts & Themes
charts.empty: No charts or themes yet. Set chart and theme folders under Library folders in Admin, then scan.

books.title: Audiobooks
books.restartConfirm: Clear your position and start over?

banner.working: Making the image. This takes 10–30 seconds.
banner.useCovers: Send top song covers as reference
banner.resetSource: Remove the banner of every {source} week
banner.costNote: Each make or edit is one paid image request. Titles are drawn by the app, not in the image.
banner.appliedShadowed: Applied. This week has its own banner, so that one stays visible.
